args.title: Brightline Freight Cold-Chain Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026" from newsletter@brightline.example): points to the main article at blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and flags a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Main article: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece (accessed with team subscription code SUB-1164): pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
